cr_data.provenance: Downtown Galleries, NYC to Oliver B. James, Phoenix, Arizona, Oliver B. James, Phoenix, Arizona to Arizona State College (University), Tempe, Arizona, January 1951 (Source: ASU Art Museum, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature. On backing: In pencil, by O'Keeffe. 'Horse's Skull on Blue/Georgia O'Keeffe' [this is probably by Stieglitz, not verified]. American Place label, same title and date '1930' Note: This should be dated 1931. See Gallery photograph." Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by The Downtown Gallery in 1950." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive date 1931. Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1930. Dated 1931 on basis of inclusion in 1931–32 New York (An American Place) exhibition and Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence, pictured in Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 51. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks.

credit_line: Collection of the Arizona State University Art Museum; Gift of Oliver B. James
description: This narrow composition features a long, bright white horse's skull. Its smooth surface contrasts with a textured background of draped blue fabric.
